Backpropagation & Optimization | 反向傳播與最佳化

Chapter 03 · Weeks 3–4 · KP01–16 Condensed | 第三章．第 3–4 週．KP01–16 精簡整合版

IDL115 · CSIE3544AB · National Dong Hwa University, Dept. of Computer Science & Engineering | 國立東華大學資訊工程學系 · 115 學年度第 1 學期

🎭 From Slope to Certainty | 從坡度到把握

👨‍🏫
Instructor: "Imagine being dropped blindfolded onto a rugged mountain range. You can't see the terrain and you have no map — the only thing you can do is feel which direction is steepest under your own feet, and take one step downhill. That feeling is the entire idea behind training a deep network."
「想像你被蒙眼空降在一片崎嶇山脈上：看不見全貌、手上也沒地圖，你唯一能做的就是用腳感受此刻哪個方向最陡，然後往下坡踏一步。這就是訓練深度網路的全部概念。」
🧑‍🎓
Student: "But a network has millions of parameters. Isn't there a smarter way than just feeling the slope, like actually computing the curvature?"
「可是網路有上百萬個參數，難道不能算曲率之類更聰明的方法，而只是感覺坡度而已？」
👨‍🏫
Instructor: "Curvature is real information — but at a million parameters, storing and inverting that curvature matrix is computationally impossible. This chapter is the story of how local slope, computed cheaply by backpropagation, becomes a training algorithm you can actually run — and how far you can trust the result once it converges."
「曲率確實是有用的資訊——但參數上百萬時，儲存並反轉曲率矩陣在運算上是不可能的。這一章要講的，就是反向傳播算出來的局部坡度如何變成一個真正跑得動的訓練演算法，以及收斂之後這個結果到底能相信到什麼程度。」

First-order optimization only ever knows the local slope, moves one step at a time, and has no view of other basins in the loss surface. | 一階最佳化永遠只知道局部坡度、一次只走一步，也看不到損失曲面上其他的山谷。

🗺️ One Chapter, Six Questions | 一章六個問題

Two-Week Route | 兩週路線

Week 3 · KP1–6 | 第 3 週

Objective, gradient, stopping, line search, momentum, and backpropagation. | 目標、梯度、停止準則、線搜索、動量與反向傳播。

Week 4 · KP7–11 | 第 4 週上半

Stochastic estimates, mini-batches, convergence behavior, AdaGrad, RMSProp, Adam. | 隨機估計、小批次、收斂行為、AdaGrad、RMSProp 與 Adam。

Week 4 · KP12–16 | 第 4 週下半

Sharpness, the SAM family, convergence guarantees, and the generalization boundary. | 尖銳度、SAM 家族、收斂保證與泛化邊界。

Pacing principle: derive the update rule before comparing optimizers; compare controls before claiming a winner. | 節奏原則：先推導更新式，再比較最佳化器；先做受控比較，再宣稱誰更好。

KP01 · Optimization Is Parameter Search | 最佳化即參數搜尋

Hypothesis | 假設類別

What functions can the model express? | 模型能表達哪些函數？

Loss | 損失

How costly is a prediction error? | 預測錯誤有多昂貴？

Optimizer | 最佳化器

Which parameter move should happen next? | 下一步參數該怎麼移動？

$$\min_\theta\;\mathcal{L}(\theta)$$

The loss ranks parameter choices; it does not itself say how to move. That is the optimizer's job — the actual training engine of the whole pipeline. | 損失替參數選擇排名，但它本身不告訴你該怎麼走；決定怎麼走是最佳化器的工作，也是整條訓練流程真正的引擎。

KP01 · One Update Step, Made Concrete | 一次更新步驟的具象化

Each parameter vector maps to one loss value; one update step is model+data→prediction→loss→gradient→new parameter. | 每個參數向量都對應一個損失值；一次更新步驟即模型＋資料→預測→損失→梯度→新參數。

KP01 · Why First Order? | 為何用一階方法？

❌ Newton's Method | 牛頓法

$$\boldsymbol{w}^{(k+1)} = \boldsymbol{w}^{(k)} - \boldsymbol{H}^{-1} \nabla f$$

💥At $d=10^6$ parameters, the Hessian has $10^{12}$ entries; inversion costs $O(d^3)$ — no GPU can afford it. | 參數 $d=10^6$ 時 Hessian 有 $10^{12}$ 個元素，求逆複雜度 $O(d^3)$，現代 GPU 完全無法負荷。
🪤In high-dimensional non-convex surfaces, Newton's method is easily attracted to saddle points. | 高維非凸曲面中，牛頓法容易被鞍點吸引。

✅ First-Order Compromise | 一階折衷

⚡Backpropagation gives one gradient vector efficiently — no Hessian required. | 反向傳播能有效算出一個梯度向量，不需要 Hessian。
📐The rest of this chapter is entirely about how to use that one signal well. | 本章後續全部都在問：如何善用這一個訊號？

KP01 · More Curvature, More Cost | 曲率更多，代價更高

Second order forms and inverts an n×n Hessian for a richer local step; first order only needs backprop's one gradient vector. | 二階需形成並反轉 n×n 的 Hessian 才能得到較豐富的局部步伐；一階只需要反向傳播算出的一個梯度向量。

KP01 · Visual Intuition | 視覺直覺

Left: local curvature can reshape the proposal. Right: a negative gradient gives a direct downhill direction. | 左：局部曲率可重塑提案；右：負梯度提供直接下坡方向。

KP02 · Gradient Descent: Learning Rate & Update Rule | 梯度下降：學習率與更新規則

For a differentiable loss, a tiny move $\Delta w$ changes the loss by approximately $\nabla f(w)^\top\Delta w$. Choosing $\Delta w=-\eta\nabla f(w)$ makes that first-order change negative. | 對可微損失，微小移動 $\Delta w$ 造成的損失變化約為 $\nabla f(w)^\top\Delta w$；取 $\Delta w=-\eta\nabla f(w)$ 便能使這個一階變化為負。

$$f(w-\eta\nabla f(w))\approx f(w)-\eta\|\nabla f(w)\|_2^2$$
1
Setup | 設定
$f(w)=5w^2-4w+1,\; f'(w)=10w-4,\; w_{t+1}=w_t-\eta f'(w_t)$
2
Start | 起點
$w_0=2,\; f'(2)=16$
3
Step | 一步
$\eta=0.05\Rightarrow w_1=2-0.05(16)=1.2$
4
Check | 檢查
$w^*=0.4$; a positive slope correctly moved $w$ left. | 正斜率使參數正確地往左移動。

KP02 · The Update Deliberately Opposes the Gradient | 更新刻意與梯度相反

At the same current parameter, the update step is deliberately opposite the gradient direction. | 在同一個目前參數點，更新方向刻意與梯度方向相反。

KP02 · Exact Loss Geometry | 精確損失幾何

All points, losses, and arrows are computed exactly from the quadratic loss $5w^2-4w+1$ at starting parameter $w_0=2$. | 所有點、損失與箭頭皆由二次損失 $5w^2-4w+1$、起始參數 2 精確計算而得。

KP02 · Learning Rate: A Trust Budget | 學習率：對局部近似的信任預算

Too Small | 太小

Safe but slow; many steps consume time. | 安全但緩慢，需要很多步。

Useful | 合適

Loss descends while local slope information remains reliable. | 損失下降，且局部斜率資訊仍然可信。

Too Large | 太大

Overshoot or instability reveals that the local linearization was trusted too far. | 越過谷底或不穩定，代表對局部線性近似信任過頭。

$$f(w-\eta\nabla f(w))\le f(w)-\eta\left(1-\frac{L\eta}{2}\right)\|\nabla f(w)\|_2^2\quad (L\text{-smooth})$$

KP02 · The Same Rule Can Converge, Land, or Diverge | 同一規則可收斂、精確抵達或發散

All curves use repeated updates on the same quadratic loss; η controls the error multiplier 1−10η. | 曲線皆由同一二次損失反覆更新而得；η 控制誤差倍率 1−10η。

KP03 · Convergence Criteria: When to Stop | 收斂準則：什麼時候該停

📉Gradient norm | 梯度範數： $\|\nabla f(w)\|\le\varepsilon$
📊Loss change | 損失變化： $|f_{t+1}-f_t|$ small enough | 足夠小
📏Parameter change | 參數變化： $\|w_{t+1}-w_t\|$ small enough | 足夠小
🧪Validation / budget | 驗證或預算： stop before wasted compute or overfitting. | 在浪費算力或過擬合之前停止。

Non-convex caution: $\nabla f=0$ may be a saddle point, not a useful minimum. | 非凸提醒：梯度為零也可能是鞍點，而非有用的極小值。

KP04 · Line Search & Steepest Descent | 線搜索與最陡下降

$$w_{t+1}=w_t-\eta_t\nabla f(w_t),\qquad f(w_t-\eta_tg_t)\le f(w_t)-c\eta_t\|g_t\|_2^2$$

Backtracking | 回溯

Try a candidate $\eta$; repeatedly shrink it until sufficient decrease holds. | 嘗試候選步長；未達充分下降就持續縮小。

Why It Matters | 為何重要

It replaces a guessed global scale with observable local evidence. | 以可觀察的局部證據取代猜測的全域尺度。

KP04 · Backtracking by Numbers | 回溯的數值檢驗

Accept/reject labels come from actually evaluating the stated loss — not a decorative path. | 接受／拒絕標示來自實際計算損失，不是裝飾性路徑。

KP05 · Momentum: Keep Agreement, Cancel Disagreement | 動量：累積一致、抵銷分歧

$$v_t=\alpha v_{t-1}-\eta\nabla F(w_t),\qquad w_{t+1}=w_t+v_t$$

Why It Helps | 為何有用

Repeated downhill components add up; alternating cross-valley components cancel. | 重複的下坡分量會累加；跨谷正負交替的分量會抵銷。

What It Cannot Do | 它不能做什麼

Momentum does not make an unsafe learning rate safe. | 動量不會把不安全的學習率變安全。

KP06 · Backpropagation: Responsibility Travels Backward | 反向傳播：責任向後傳

The loss only sees an output. A hidden parameter affects that output through every downstream operation; the chain rule turns that dependency into a product of local factors. | 損失只看到輸出；隱藏參數透過每一個下游運算影響輸出，鏈式法則把這個依賴關係拆成一連串局部因子的乘積。

$$\frac{\partial L}{\partial w_{ij}}=\frac{\partial L}{\partial a_i}\frac{\partial a_i}{\partial w_{ij}}=\delta_i z_j$$

KP06 · Forward Stores What Backward Needs | 前向保存反向需要的量

Blue arrows compute values forward; red dashed arrows propagate sensitivities backward. | 藍色箭頭前向計算數值；紅色虛線箭頭反向傳遞敏感度。

KP06 · Chain Rule, Read Right to Left | 鏈式法則：由右往左讀

$$L=\frac12(\hat y-y)^2,\quad \hat y=w_2z,\quad z=\sigma(a),\quad a=w_1x$$ $$\frac{\partial L}{\partial w_1}=(\hat y-y)\cdot w_2\cdot\sigma'(a)\cdot x$$

Change $w_1$ → changes $a$ → changes $z$ → changes $\hat y$ → changes the loss. One downstream effect becomes a product of local effects. | 改變 $w_1$ 依序改變 $a,z,\hat y$ 與損失；一個下游影響拆成一連串局部影響的乘積。

$$\delta^{(L)}=\nabla_{a^{(L)}}L,\qquad \delta^{(\ell)}=\left(W^{(\ell+1)\top}\delta^{(\ell+1)}\right)\odot\sigma'(a^{(\ell)})$$

δ answers one question: if this pre-activation moves, how does the loss move? Downstream weights say how strongly this unit influences later units; the activation derivative gates whether that influence can pass onward. | δ 只回答一個問題：這個 pre-activation 改變時，損失如何改變？下游權重說明此單元對後續單元的影響強度；活化函數的導數則決定這個影響能否被傳遞下去。

KP06 · Hand Computation Before Trusting a Library | 在信任函式庫前先手算一次

1
Forward | 前向
$x=1,\;w_1=2,\;w_2=3,\;y=0\;\Rightarrow\;a=2,\;z=a,\;\hat y=6,\;L=\tfrac12(6-0)^2=18$
2
Backward | 反向
$\delta_{out}=\hat y-y=6$
3
Gradients | 梯度
$\frac{\partial L}{\partial w_2}=6\cdot2=12,\qquad \frac{\partial L}{\partial w_1}=6\cdot3\cdot1\cdot1=18$

Every factor has a causal role; none is a memorization ornament. | 每個因子都有因果角色，沒有一個只是死背裝飾。

KP06 · Hand-Computed Credit, by the Numbers | 手算歸因的具體數字

Every arrow carries the exact number computed in the previous step — nothing here is symbolic shorthand. | 每一個箭頭都對應前一步驟算出的確切數字，這裡沒有任何符號化的簡寫。

KP06 · Gradient Check: Two Nearby Losses Audit One Derivative | 梯度檢查：兩個附近的損失稽核一個導數

$$\frac{\partial L}{\partial w}\approx\frac{L(w+\epsilon)-L(w-\epsilon)}{2\epsilon}$$

Why Central Difference | 為何用中心差分

The first-order approximation error cancels between the two sides. | 兩側相減會抵銷一階近似誤差。

Why Not Infinitely Small | 為何不能無限小

Floating-point round-off eventually dominates. | 浮點數捨入誤差最終會主導結果。

Week 3 · Verification Lab | 第 3 週驗證實作

Autograd is an independent witness — not a replacement for reasoning. | Autograd 是獨立證人，不取代理解。

1
Specify | 確立規格
Fix the tiny network, loss, values, and expected tensors. | 固定小型網路、損失、數值與預期張量。
2
Implement | 實作
Ask an agent to write a small PyTorch comparison harness. | 請 AI agent 撰寫小型 PyTorch 比較框架。
3
Verify | 驗證
Compare manual gradients, autograd, and finite differences. | 比較手算梯度、autograd 與有限差分結果。

Human responsibility: review the diff, rerun the tests, and be able to explain any mismatch. | 人類的責任：檢視差異、重新跑測試，並能解釋任何不一致之處。

✅ Checkpoint · KP01–06 | 檢核點

1
Retrieval | 提取練習
What computes $\nabla_\theta L$? What decides whether to use a batch, history, or an adaptive scale? | 誰計算梯度 $\nabla_\theta L$？誰決定是否使用批次、歷史或自適應尺度？
✅ Answer | 答案：
Backpropagation computes the gradient through the computational graph; the optimizer decides how that gradient is estimated and turned into an update. | 反向傳播透過計算圖求出梯度；最佳化器則決定如何估計並把梯度轉成一次更新。

🎭 Week 4 · The Gradient Stays, the Update Rule Changes | 梯度不變，更新規則改變

👨‍🏫
Instructor: "Backpropagation already handed us one gradient. From here on, every optimizer in this chapter takes that exact same signal and simply asks: what should I remember about it, and how should that memory reshape the step?"
「反向傳播已經給了我們一個梯度。從這裡開始，本章的每一個最佳化器拿到的都是同一個訊號，差別只在於：該記住這個訊號的哪些歷史，而這段記憶又該如何重塑這一步的移動。」

Same current gradient, three different memories, three different steps — this is the entire design space this chapter explores. | 同一個目前梯度，三種不同的記憶，三種不同的步長——這就是本章要探索的整個設計空間。

Same Current Gradient, Three Update Rules | 同一個當前梯度，三種更新規則

SGD uses only the present gradient; Momentum adds direction memory; Adam adds both direction and scale memory. | SGD 只用當前梯度；動量加入方向記憶；Adam 同時加入方向與尺度記憶。

KP07 · Stochastic Gradient Descent | 隨機梯度下降

$$F(w)=\frac1n\sum_{i=1}^n f_i(w),\qquad w_{t+1}=w_t-\eta_t\nabla f_{i_t}(w_t)$$

Uniform sampling gives $\mathbb{E}[\nabla f_{i_t}(w_t)]=\nabla F(w_t)$ — the estimate is unbiased. | 均勻抽樣時，單筆梯度的期望值等於完整梯度，估計是無偏的。

Unbiased does not mean every single step descends. | 無偏不代表每一步都真的下降。

KP07–08 · Smaller Batches Trade Exactness for Frequency | 小批次以精確度換取更新頻率

All three paths optimize the same mean objective; only the gradient estimate changes. | 三條路徑最佳化的是同一個平均目標，差別只在梯度估計方式。

KP08 · Mini-Batch & Epoch | 小批次與 Epoch

$$g_B(w)=\frac1{|B|}\sum_{i\in B}\nabla f_i(w),\qquad w_{t+1}=w_t-\eta_tg_B(w)$$

Batch Size | 批次大小

Controls noise, memory, and updates per epoch. | 控制雜訊、記憶體用量與每 epoch 的更新次數。

Shuffle | 洗牌

Prevents a fixed sample order from becoming a hidden condition. | 避免固定的樣本順序變成隱藏條件。

Epoch | 訓練週期

Not a universal compute unit — also compare steps and examples seen. | 並非通用的算力單位，也應比較步數與看過的樣本量。

2
Batch Arithmetic | 批次手算
At one $w$, four per-example gradients are $3,1,-1,-3$. What are the average gradients for batches $\{1,2\}$ and $\{3,4\}$? | 四筆樣本在同一個 $w$ 的梯度為 $3,1,-1,-3$，兩個批次 $\{1,2\}$ 與 $\{3,4\}$ 的平均梯度分別是多少？
✅ Answer | 答案：
$g_{\{1,2\}}=2$, $g_{\{3,4\}}=-2$, while the full average is $0$ — a mini-batch estimate can point away from the full gradient. | 前批平均為 2，後批平均為 −2，而完整平均為 0——小批次估計的方向可能與完整梯度不同。

KP09 · SGD Convergence: Noise Changes What “Arrive” Means | SGD 收斂：雜訊改變「抵達」的意義

Full Gradient | 完整梯度

Under convex, smooth assumptions, the objective residual can shrink at rate $O(1/t)$. | 凸且平滑的假設下，目標殘差可以 $O(1/t)$ 的速率縮小。

Fixed-Step SGD | 固定步長 SGD

Noise can leave the iterate in an $O(\eta)$ neighborhood rather than exactly at a minimizer. | 雜訊會使迭代停留在約 $O(\eta)$ 的鄰域內，而非精確抵達最小值。

$$\eta_t\downarrow0,\qquad \sum_t\eta_t=\infty,\qquad\sum_t\eta_t^2<\infty$$

Diminish noise without stopping progress — the classic Robbins–Monro step-size conditions. | 逐漸降低雜訊但不停止前進——經典的 Robbins–Monro 步長條件。

KP10 · AdaGrad: Per-Coordinate Adaptive Steps | AdaGrad：逐維度自適應步長

$$G_{t,j}=\sum_{s=1}^{t}g_{s,j}^2,\qquad w_{t+1,j}=w_{t,j}-\eta\frac{g_{t,j}}{\sqrt{G_{t,j}+\epsilon}}$$

Frequent large gradients accumulate and receive smaller effective steps; rare coordinates keep relatively larger steps. | 經常出現的大梯度會累積並得到較小的有效步長；稀少座標則相對保留較大的步長。

KP10–11 · AdaGrad Never Forgets; RMSProp Deliberately Does | AdaGrad 不遺忘；RMSProp 刻意遺忘

Both curves are computed from the exact same gradient history — only the accumulation rule differs. | 兩條曲線皆採用相同的梯度歷史，差別只在累積規則。

KP11 · Adam: Direction Memory + Scale Memory | Adam：方向記憶＋尺度記憶

$$m_t=\beta_1m_{t-1}+(1-\beta_1)g_t,\quad v_t=\beta_2v_{t-1}+(1-\beta_2)g_t^2$$ $$w_{t+1}=w_t-\eta\frac{\hat m_t}{\sqrt{\hat v_t}+\epsilon}$$

$m_t$ — Smoothed Direction | 平滑方向

An exponential moving average of the gradient itself. | 梯度本身的指數移動平均。

$v_t$ — Recent Squared Scale | 近期平方尺度

Tracks how large recent gradients have been, coordinate-wise. | 逐座標追蹤近期梯度的大小。

Bias correction ($\hat m_t,\hat v_t$) fixes the early under-estimate caused by zero initialization. | 偏差修正（$\hat m_t,\hat v_t$）修正零初始化造成的早期低估。

Optimizer Comparison Is an Experiment, Not a Leaderboard | 最佳化器比較是實驗，不是排行榜

SGDMomentumAdam
Stored state | 儲存狀態none | 無$v_{t-1}$$m_{t-1}, v_{t-1}$
Uses | 使用current gradient | 當前梯度direction history | 方向歷史direction + scale | 方向＋尺度
🔬Protocol | 實驗協定： fix data, model, seeds, schedule, and compute budget. | 固定資料、模型、種子、排程與算力預算。
📋Log | 記錄： training loss, validation metric, wall time, and variance across seeds. | 訓練損失、驗證指標、實際時間與跨種子變異。

KP12 · Flat Minima & the Motivation for SAM | 平坦極小值與 SAM 的動機

$$\operatorname{sharp}_\rho(w)=\max_{\|\epsilon\|_2\le\rho}\left[\mathcal L(w+\epsilon)-\mathcal L(w)\right]$$

Do not only ask how low the loss is here — ask how bad it becomes nearby. Flatness is a local diagnostic and motivation, not a parameterization-free proof of generalization. | 不只要問這裡的損失有多低，也要問附近的損失會變得多糟。平坦性是一種局部診斷與動機，不是與參數化無關的泛化證明。

KP12 · Sharp and Flat Pay Different Penalties at the Same Radius | 同樣半徑下尖銳與平坦的代價不同

The curves and neighborhood penalties are calculated exactly from the plotted quadratics. | 曲線與鄰域代價皆由圖中的二次函數精確計算而得。

KP13 · Vanilla SAM: Probe the Worst Direction First | 基本 SAM：先探測最壞方向

$$\min_w\max_{\|\epsilon\|_2\le\rho}\mathcal L(w+\epsilon),\qquad \epsilon^*\approx\rho\frac{\nabla\mathcal L(w)}{\|\nabla\mathcal L(w)\|_2}$$ $$w\leftarrow w-\eta\nabla\mathcal L(w+\epsilon^*)$$

First-order reason: the inner loss rises fastest along the gradient direction, so that direction is spent as the perturbation. | 一階理由：內層損失沿梯度方向上升最快，因此把這個方向當作擾動來使用。

KP13 · SAM Spends the Radius Along the Gradient | SAM 沿梯度方向使用半徑

The green arrow is the calculated perturbation inside the blue radius. | 綠色箭頭是藍色半徑範圍內計算出的擾動。

KP14 · Efficient & Adaptive SAM | 高效與自適應 SAM

SWP

Perturb a stochastic subset of weights. | 擾動隨機子集的權重。

SDS

Spend compute on sharpness-sensitive examples. | 把計算資源花在對尖銳度敏感的樣本上。

ASAM

Use a scale-aware neighborhood. | 使用考慮參數尺度的鄰域。

Ask which part actually changed: compute budget, sample selection, or neighborhood geometry. | 要問清楚改變的到底是計算預算、樣本選擇，還是鄰域幾何。

KP15 · Convergence Guarantees Are Conditional, Not a Slogan | 收斂保證是有條件的敘述，不是口號

Typical Assumptions | 典型假設

Width, initialization, data separation, smoothness, and step-size choices are all explicitly specified. | 明定寬度、初始化方式、資料分離性、平滑性與步長選擇。

Typical Conclusion | 典型結論

Training loss can become small within a stated computation budget. | 訓練損失可以在指定的計算量內變小。

$$\text{assumptions}\Longrightarrow \mathcal L_{train}(w_T)\le\varepsilon\quad\not\Longrightarrow\quad \mathcal L_{test}\text{ is small}$$

KP16 · Optimization Does Not Finish the Generalization Story | 最佳化理論沒有結束泛化的故事

Optimization | 最佳化

Can we lower the training objective? | 能否降低訓練目標？

Generalization | 泛化

Does performance transfer to unseen data? | 表現能否遷移到未見過的資料？

Evaluation | 評估

Which validation, robustness, and cost evidence exists? | 有哪些驗證、穩健性與成本方面的證據？

The same training loss can coexist with very different test-time behavior. | 相同的訓練損失可以對應到截然不同的測試表現。

KP16 · A Training Result Is One Checkpoint, Not the Final Verdict | 訓練結果是一個檢查點，不是最終判決

Train, validation, and test each answer a different question — a low training loss is a result of the chain, not proof that it generalizes. | 訓練、驗證與測試各自回答不同問題；低訓練損失是這條鏈的結果，不是泛化的證明。

✅ Chapter Retrieval | 全章提取

3
Match Method to Job | 配對方法與工作
Match each question to its tool: “Who receives credit?”, “How can I estimate cheaply?”, “How do I damp zigzag?”, “How do I penalize a bad neighbor?”, “What still needs test evidence?” | 把五個問題配對到對應的工具。
✅ Answer | 答案：
Backpropagation; SGD / mini-batch; Momentum / Adam; SAM; validation and generalization analysis. | 依序是：反向傳播；SGD／小批次；動量／Adam；SAM；驗證與泛化分析。

Chapter 03 · Closing | 本章收束

Compute correctly. Move deliberately. Claim carefully. | 正確計算。審慎移動。謹慎主張。

$$\text{loss}\to\text{gradient}\to\text{update rule}\to\text{training behavior}\to\text{validation evidence}$$
